# @zakkster/lite-audio-pool
> Zero-GC Web Audio sound sprite pool. Voice stealing with 20ms anti-pop fade, pitch shifting, stereo pan, bus routing, ABA-safe handles.

## Install
npm i @zakkster/lite-audio-pool

## Import
import { AudioPool } from '@zakkster/lite-audio-pool';

## Key Facts
- Zero GC on the hot path: all state in TypedArrays, `onended` handler bound once per pool (not per play)
- Size: ~2 KB minified, < 1 KB gzipped
- Dependencies: none
- ESM only (type: module)
- Voice stealing with 20 ms anti-pop fade
- Generation-stamped handles: `play()` returns `((gen << 8) | channel) >>> 0`, stale handles are silent no-ops on `stop()`
- Bus routing via constructor `output` param
- Per-play buffer override via `play()` 5th arg
- Constructor validates capacity and sprite table; typos fail at wiring, not at first shot
- `expireTimes` are f64 - stays precise at 24h+ of AudioContext uptime

## Export: AudioPool (class)

### Constructor
```
new AudioPool(ctx, audioBuffer, spriteMap, capacity?, output?)
```
- `ctx: AudioContext` (required)
- `audioBuffer: AudioBuffer` - default decoded sprite file
- `spriteMap: Record<string, { start: number, duration: number }>` (required; validated)
- `capacity?: number` - integer in [1, 256], defaults to 32. Out-of-range throws `RangeError`.
- `output?: AudioNode | null` - defaults to `ctx.destination`. Pass a GainNode to route into a bus.

Throws `TypeError` on missing ctx/spriteMap or malformed sprites. Throws `RangeError` on invalid capacity.

### play(spriteId, volume?, pan?, pitch?, buffer?)
Returns a packed handle `((gen << 8) | channel) >>> 0`, or `-1` if spriteId is unknown.
- Pass handle to `stop()` for ABA-safe stopping.
- First play on a virgin channel: gen=0, handle equals channel index (backwards-compatible for opaque usage).
- `buffer?: AudioBuffer | null` - optional per-play buffer override.
- Pan is scheduled at start-time so a stolen voice keeps its pan through its fade-out.

### stop(handle)
Stops the specific play. Stale handles (channel stolen or already ended) are silent no-ops.

### isPlaying(handle)
Returns `true` iff the handle still names a sounding voice. Same test `stop()` runs internally.

### activeCount()
Returns the number of currently sounding voices (0..capacity). Allocation-free.

### stopAll()
Stops every active channel, invalidates all previously issued handles.

### destroy()
Stops all sounds, disconnects every node the pool built, releases references. Idempotent.

See source file AudioPool.js for full JSDoc and inline comments.
